parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Search for existing forecasts in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter and sort objects based on various criteria, providing a flexible way to retrieve specific data. It is useful for finding objects that match certain properties or conditions.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object to read.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to retrieve (forecast).

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

id.description: The unique identifier for the associated object. It is a string.

type.description: The type of association between the objects. It is a string.

AssociatedId.description: Contains the id and type of an association

results.description: An array of associated IDs, each represented by an object of type AssociatedId.

CollectionResponseAssociatedId.description: Represents a collection of associated IDs returned by an API request, including pagination details for navigating through the results.

results.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectWithAssociations, each representing a CRM object and its associated data.

CollectionResponseSimplePublicObjectWith.description: Represents a paginated collection response that includes simple public objects with their associations. This component is used to handle the results and pagination details when retrieving a list of objects from the API.

results.description: An array of SimplePublicObject items, each representing an individual object in the collection.

CollectionResponseWithTotalSimplePublicO.description: Represents a list of simple objects returned from an API request, along with the total count of objects available.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for the request. Include this value with any error reports or support tickets

links.description: A map of link names to associated URIs containing documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error

Error.description: Represents an error response returned by the API when an operation fails. This component is used in various endpoints to provide detailed information about the error encountered.

example.message: Invalid input (details will vary based on the error)

code.description: The status code associated with the error detail

in.description: The name of the field or parameter in which the error was found.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error

ErrorDetail.description: Represents detailed information about an error that occurred in the API. This component is used to provide additional context and specifics about errors, typically as part of an error response.

highValue.description: The upper bound value used for range queries. It is a string.

operator.description: The operator that defines the type of comparison to be performed. Valid values include 'EQ', 'NEQ', 'LT', 'LTE', 'GT', 'GTE', 'BETWEEN', 'IN', 'NOT_IN', 'HAS_PROPERTY', 'NOT_HAS_PROPERTY', 'CONTAINS_TOKEN', and 'NOT_CONTAINS_TOKEN'.

propertyName.description: The name of the property on which the filter is applied. It is a string.

value.description: The value to compare against the property specified by propertyName. It is a string.

values.description: An array of string values used for multi-value comparisons.

Filter.description: Defines a single condition for searching CRM objects, specifying the property to filter on, the operator to use (such as equals, greater than, or contains), and the value(s) to compare against.

filters.description: An array of filter objects that define the criteria for the search. Each filter specifies a property, an operator, and a value to match against.

FilterGroup.description: Represents a group of filters used to query data within HubSpot. This component is used to define criteria for filtering records in various API endpoints.

ForwardPaging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

after.description: A string token used to retrieve the next page of results.

link.description: A string URL that provides the link to the next page of results.

NextPage.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

Paging.description: Represents the pagination information for navigating through a list of results in the API. It provides details on how to access the previous or next set of results.

before.description: A string token that indicates the position before the current page, used for navigating to the previous page in a paginated list.

link.description: A string URL that provides a direct link to the previous page of results.

PreviousPage.description: specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the previous set of results in a paginated API response

after.description: A string used as a paging cursor token to retrieve results after a specific point.

filterGroups.description: An array of filter groups to apply to the search. Each filter group contains multiple filters that define the search criteria.

limit.description: An integer specifying the maximum number of results to return.

properties.description: An array of strings specifying which properties of the objects should be returned in the search results.

query.description: A string representing the search query to be applied.

sorts.description: An array of strings indicating the sorting order of the search results.

category.description: A string indicating the category of the warning.

context.description: An object containing additional context about the warning, with string properties.

message.description: A string containing the warning message.

PublicObjectWarning.description: Represents a warning message related to a public object in HubSpot, providing details about the nature and context of the warning.

archived.description: A boolean indicating whether this object is archived.

archivedAt.description: The date and time when this object was archived, in ISO 8601 format.

createdAt.description: The date and time when this object was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for this object, represented as a string.

objectWriteTraceId.description: A string representing the trace ID for write operations on this object.

properties.description: A map of property names to their values, where each value is a string.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to their historical values, each represented as an array of ValueWithTimestamp objects.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: A string containing the URL associated with this object.

warnings.description: An array of warnings related to this object, each represented as a PublicObjectWarning.

archived.description: A boolean indicating whether this CRM object is archived.

archivedAt.description: The date and time when this CRM object was archived, in ISO 8601 format.

associations.description: A map of associated object types to their associated IDs for this CRM object.

createdAt.description: The date and time when this CRM object was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for this CRM object.

objectWriteTraceId.description: A trace ID used for tracking changes to this CRM object.

properties.description: A map of property names to their current values for this CRM object.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to their values along with a history of changes, including timestamps.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this CRM object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: The URL where this CRM object can be accessed.

warnings.description: An array of warnings related to this CRM object, each containing a category, message, and context.

SimplePublicObjectWithAssociations.description: Represents a CRM object along with its properties, timestamps, and a set of associated object IDs grouped by association type.

sourceId.description: The unique identifier of the source from which the value originated, represented as a string.

sourceLabel.description: A label describing the source of the value, represented as a string.

sourceType.description: The type of source from which the value originated, represented as a string.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the value was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who updated the value, represented as an integer.

value.description: The value associated with the timestamp, represented as a string.
